issues.description: Unbounded in-memory buffer for early log records can grow without limit on long pre-connect hangs
issues.detail: _BufferingHandler.buffer is an unbounded list. If a job hangs or loops before init_recording/cleanup (e.g., slow startup logging at DEBUG), memory grows unbounded in the worker process. Consider a maxlen deque or size cap with a dropped-records counter so a single stuck job can't OOM the executor.

issues.description: _shutdown_telemetry removes ALL LoggingHandlers globally, including user-added ones
issues.detail: The new loop in _shutdown_telemetry iterates root handlers and removes every LoggingHandler instance. If a user or another subsystem attached their own opentelemetry LoggingHandler (different provider), it will be silently detached. Track the specific handler added by _setup_cloud_tracer and remove only that one.

issues.description: Crash-path init_recording forces logs=True even when user disabled log recording
issues.detail: In _on_cleanup, when _recording_initialized is False, init_recording(RecordingOptions(logs=True, ...)) is called unconditionally. The PR description says "still honor user-specified record settings," but server/user RecordingOptions are ignored here since session.start() never ran. This may upload logs against user/job intent.

issues.description: Replay path matches first LoggingHandler on root logger, which may not be the OTLP one just installed
issues.detail: _flush_early_log_buffer iterates root.handlers and emits buffered records to the first opentelemetry LoggingHandler found. If multiple LoggingHandlers exist (or one was attached by user code earlier), replay can target the wrong handler. Capture the specific handler reference inside _setup_cloud_tracer and pass it through.

issues.description: Disabling pytest-xdist (-n auto) and dropping test_plugin_google_stt without explanation
issues.detail: The makefile change serializes the unit-test suite (removing -n auto) and removes tests/test_plugin_google_stt.py from CI. This will materially slow CI and silently drop coverage of the Google STT plugin. If intentional, the PR should justify it; otherwise this looks like an accidental local debug change leaking in.

issues.description: Bare `except Exception` in _on_cleanup swallows context that could explain crash-log upload failures
issues.detail: The except in _on_cleanup logs via logger.exception but then calls _stop_log_buffering, dropping the buffered crash logs entirely. Consider falling back to a local-file dump or stderr replay so operators still see the crash trail when OTLP init fails — otherwise the very logs we wanted are lost.

review.summary: The PR's core idea — buffer logs early and flush on crash — is sound, but several rough edges remain. The biggest functional concerns are an unbounded in-memory log buffer, removal of all OTLP LoggingHandlers globally during shutdown, and ignoring user-specified RecordingOptions on the crash path. The makefile changes (dropping -n auto and removing a test file) look unrelated and should be justified or reverted. The replay logic should track the specific OTLP handler reference rather than scanning root handlers.
